title: Isandro and the Radiators
author: Xanthe Dunmore
blurb: Sable Voss, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
